title: Amplitude-Only FFN Intervention for Tool-Structured LLM Inference: Method, Gated Evaluation Protocol, and Cross-Model Empirical Results
abstract: arXiv:2607.11183v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study Amplitude Gating (AG), an inference-time intervention that masks feed-forward network (FFN) activation coordinates while keeping pretrained weights fixed. Six SwiGLU sites separate shared and gate-only inputs, expanded gate/value channels, and the FFN output. Magnitude-ranked entropy masks and a Newton-Schulz windowed ranking variant provide alternative forward paths without retraining. The corrected September collection covers three Qwen checkpoints and eight text/tool endpoints. translated_title: 面向工具结构化大语言模型推理的仅幅度FFN干预：方法、门控评估协议与跨模型实证结果
translated_abstract: 我们研究了幅度门控，这是一种推理时干预方法，在前馈网络（FFN）激活坐标上进行掩码操作，同时保持预训练权重固定。六个SwiGLU位置分别对共享输入与仅门控输入、扩展的门控/数值通道以及FFN输出进行分离。幅度排序熵掩码和Newton-Schulz窗口排序变体提供了无需重新训练的替代前向路径。修正后的九月数据集涵盖三个Qwen检查点和八个文本/工具端点。在冻结的本地文本评分器下，所展示的Qwen3.5-9B非NS配置在两个函数调用端点上分别提升了2.61和2.67个百分点（pp），在静态ToolBench的域内/域外端点上分别提升了1.64和2.82个百分点。将较低的历史/九月AG均值与较高的基线均值进行比较，在这些路径上仍保留正的裕度。这支持了对所观测的两次执行的鲁棒性，而非形式上的统计显著性。
tldr: 该论文提出幅度门控（AG）这一无需重训练的推理时干预方法，通过掩码FFN激活坐标，在多个Qwen模型的函数调用和ToolBench端点上实现了1.6至2.8个百分点的稳定性能提升。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Amplitude Gating (AG), a training-free inference-time intervention that masks FFN activation coordinates, achieving consistent improvements of 1.6 to 2.8 percentage points across function-call and ToolBench endpoints on multiple Qwen models.
